Hi Alex —

Thanks for taking the time today to walk through Acme's requirements and current infra. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing features, centralize model serving, and get clear cost/perf estimates.
- Current constraints: bursty traffic spikes, on-prem data restrictions for some logs, and a preference for predictable latency.

Next step we discussed: technical deep dive/demo for your infra and a sample workload so we can size an appropriate Dedicated plan and show a short live run. Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Mar 24, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Mar 25, 14:00–15:00 PT

Can you confirm which option works and who from your side will attend (roles/names)? Also let us know if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet and whether there are any NDAs or procurement folks we should loop in before the session.

I've attached a 1-page proposed agenda for the demo. Rishi (solutions) and Dev (technical account lead) will join from our side.

Thanks —
